findings.analysis: Added BUILD_SYSTEM_PROMPT and SUBAGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT constants to system_prompts.py. Updated BuildAgent and SubAgentAgent to use these as default fallbacks instead of returning None or inline strings. All 3 agents now return a proper default system prompt when none is provided.
deliverables: system_prompts.py — BUILD_SYSTEM_PROMPT (coding assistant), SUBAGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT (focused subtask) constants
build.py — get_system_prompt() returns BUILD_SYSTEM_PROMPT when no custom prompt given
subagent.py — get_system_prompt() returns SUBAGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT constant instead of inline string
tests/test_system_prompts.py — 14 tests (constants defined, distinct, default fallback, custom override, mode checks)
